# Samsung Cloud
> Samsung Cloud provides cloud backup, sync, restore, and device data management services for Samsung users.

Samsung Cloud helps users store and restore supported Samsung device data, manage synced content, and understand service availability, account usage, and feature changes.

## Service Overview
- [Samsung Cloud Home](https://www.samsungcloud.com/): Main entry point for Samsung Cloud service information and account access.
- [Support](https://www.samsungcloud.com/support): Central support hub for Samsung Cloud help and service guidance.
- [Notice](https://www.samsungcloud.com/notice): Official notices about Samsung Cloud service updates, changes, and announcements.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.samsungcloud.com/terms): Service terms governing Samsung Cloud usage and features.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.samsungcloud.com/privacy): Privacy information describing handling of Samsung Cloud user data.

## Account and Access
- [Sign In](https://www.samsungcloud.com/login): Account sign-in page for accessing Samsung Cloud services and settings.
- [Find ID](https://www.samsungcloud.com/findId): Account recovery page for locating a Samsung account ID.
- [Reset Password](https://www.samsungcloud.com/resetPassword): Password recovery page for regaining access to a Samsung account.
- [Account Management](https://www.samsungcloud.com/account): Manage Samsung account details related to Samsung Cloud access.

## Backup and Restore
- [Backup Guide](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/backup): Overview of backing up supported device data to Samsung Cloud.
- [Restore Guide](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/restore): Instructions for restoring backed-up Samsung Cloud data to a device.
- [Sync and Backup Settings](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/settings): Guidance for configuring backup and sync options on supported devices.
- [Device Data Support](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/data): Details on which categories of device data can be backed up.

## Gallery and Sync
- [Gallery Sync](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/gallery): Information about gallery synchronization and related service behavior.
- [OneDrive Migration Notice](https://www.samsungcloud.com/notice/onedrive): Details about gallery sync changes and Microsoft OneDrive integration.
- [Cloud Sync Guide](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/sync): Instructions for syncing supported content across Samsung devices.
- [Manage Synced Data](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/manage-sync): Guidance for reviewing and managing synced cloud content.

## Storage and Data Management
- [Storage Usage](https://www.samsungcloud.com/storage): View storage usage and understand Samsung Cloud capacity limits.
- [Manage Cloud Data](https://www.samsungcloud.com/manage): Tools and guidance for deleting or organizing stored cloud data.
- [Download Data](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/download): Instructions for downloading supported data from Samsung Cloud.
- [Delete Backups](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/delete): Guidance for removing backups and clearing stored device data.

## Device Support
- [Supported Devices](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/devices): Information on Samsung devices and models supported by Samsung Cloud.
- [Supported Data Types](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/supported-data): List of data categories available for backup, restore, or sync.
- [Region Availability](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/region): Details on regional availability and service limitations.
- [Service Requirements](https://www.samsungcloud.com/guide/requirements): Requirements for using Samsung Cloud on compatible devices.

## Help and Troubleshooting
- [FAQ](https://www.samsungcloud.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about Samsung Cloud features and account usage.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.samsungcloud.com/troubleshooting): Help for common Samsung Cloud errors, sync issues, and restore problems.
- [Contact Support](https://www.samsungcloud.com/contact): Support contact options for Samsung Cloud assistance.
- [Service Status Notices](https://www.samsungcloud.com/notice/service): Notices related to service interruptions, maintenance, and operational changes.

## Legal and Policy
- [Terms of Service](https://www.samsungcloud.com/terms): Legal terms for Samsung Cloud service access and use.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.samsungcloud.com/privacy): Privacy disclosures relevant to Samsung Cloud accounts and stored data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.samsungcloud.com/cookies): Information about cookies and related tracking technologies.
- [Open Source Licenses](https://www.samsungcloud.com/opensource): Open source software notices and license information.
